alert: the metrics service (prometheus) keeps going down and restarting
note: Rebuilt from stored benchmark results (evals/results/prometheus-bad-scrape-crash.json, session 2026-10-29T01:14:24.129Z, agent run 1). The agent's text, its thinking and the tool outputs were not recorded. Turns and tool names come from the run's trace; arguments are shown only where a citation identifies the call. The report, citations and verification are the stored originals.

report.summary: Prometheus (3.10.0) is crash-looping (restartCount 9). It panics with a slice-bounds runtime error in its text parser a few seconds after each start, as soon as it scrapes the metrics-target.
report.root_cause: Prometheus crashes inside its Prometheus text-format parser (PromParser.Labels at model/textparse/promparse.go:237) while processing the scrape response from metrics-target. The scrape returns a malformed 5-byte /metrics body, and the parser hits an unchecked slice index ([2:1]). The panic kills the whole process, and the restart policy brings it back, so the loop repeats on every scrape. The trigger is the malformed payload served by metrics-target, combined with a parser bug in this Prometheus build that panics instead of rejecting the bad input. The metrics-target is only observed serving a 5-byte body (its nginx access log); I could not read the body itself or the Prometheus config, so the exact payload is inferred. order-service, postgres and the gateway are not involved.
